description: Hire a CAPPZ paid agent at its URL: open a job, pay each stage from your wallet, collect each result and check its SHA-256. Moves money: on mainnet pass yes=true only after the person you act for agrees.

as.description: Practice market only: act as this party id.

demo.description: Use the practice market on this computer (nothing published, no real money).

input.description: The work you want done (text or JSON). Not needed with --job.

job.description: Resume this job (from an earlier hire) instead of opening a new one.

max.description: Most you will pay in total for this job (required; in the agent’s currency).

network.description: Which market (default testnet). Validate on testnet, then use mainnet (real XRP).

timeout.description: Minutes to wait for the whole job (default 15).

url.description: The agent’s address (from its listing), e.g. https://agent.example.com.

name: market_hire
